items.title: Neon Colorblock Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Glow around the city while having the most modern outfits around! With 12 teen skins that are designed around everyone’s favourite fashion trend of colorblocking, you’ll have the dream closet filled with these neon rainbow clothes.

- 12 skins
- Cool fashion
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Parkour Dimensions
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Parkour is fun! 

Parkour through the Parkour Dimensions! A beautifully crafted parkour experience!

Become a parkour pro!

items.title: Anime Monsters
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: These monstrous anime creatures have risen from the underworld and are determined to take you on the scariest of adventures. Be it as friends or foes, these 11 anime skins will be sure to make life both terrifying and interesting.

items.title: Dog Onesies
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Impress your friends with your favorite Dog Onesies! Choose from 6 different styles and show off your appreciation for humanity's best friend!

- Beagle!
- Dalmatian!
- Husky!
- Pug!
- Shiba Inu!
- St. Bernard!
- 48 total skins to choose from!

By Fantasize Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: A Tribute to the Real Heroes
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's true what they say, not all heroes wear capes. Some wear scrubs, lab coats, masks, and jumpsuits, and now you can portray these heroes in the form of doctors, scientists, and more with this skin pack of a variety of workers in their professions.

- Includes 8 HD skins!
- Male and female options with a variety of unique clothing
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Capture the Flag
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Everyone knows the classic game of capture the flag: avoid being caught, capture a flag, and bring it back to your base! If it sounds like your type of game, wait until you play it virtually without having to break a sweat!

- Challenge your friends to the ultimate keep-away
- How many points can you score without being tagged?
- By PixelPoly Digital & Pathway Studios

items.title: Modern House 7
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Decorate this amazing modern house with over 60 pieces of furniture!
The furniture consists of everything from a pool table to a giant TV. 
You can also use the helicopter to explore the world, or drive the car through the underwater tunnel!

+ Over 60 pieces of furniture
+ Over 10 vehicles
+ Over 40 animals
+ Rotate and color tool

items.title: Anime Animals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These anime animals have human forms! Which animal will you choose to dress up as today? There's a cute panda, frog and so much more!

- 9 skins

items.title: Rainbow Box
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Check out these beautiful rainbow designs! Make sure to add these skins to your pattern collection because they are just too cute!

- 12 colorful skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Lucky Blocks in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Ready to test your luck? Will your success be based on good fortune or your own skill? These lucky block suits are perfect for wild card players who are willing to let the dice decide their course of action!

- Includes 10 lucky block headed skins!

items.title: Street Style
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Whether you like the casual style or prefer something more wild, the 'Street Style' skin set has it all! Pick from a wide variety of outfits, from casual wear to high fashion outfits!

- 8 different skins!
- Pick from a variety of luxury clothing styles!

items.title: Freestyle HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Love the classic skins but want something a little more fresh and detailed? Feel free to express yourself among your friends with these teen styles! Backwards hats, horns, stripes, and more to choose from as you upgrade your fashion with this skin pack.

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Ender Slime HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
From the depths of the warped forest within the nether spawn creatures who derive from the enderman. Ghastly purple ghouls that have been encased in glass due to their slime based bodies. Be an ender slime that mimics other mobs or has a unique look all it's own!

+ 8 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: City Fairies
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Fly! Be free! Roam the city as the beautiful fairy you were meant to be!

+ 15 fairy-themed skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Dye Your Hair!
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Welcome into a new rebel era! Try out fancy outfits, combine them with the craziest hair colors and rock this world! Speed down the road and let yourself shine. Be brave like these teens and try out all the possible colors while making an entrance into this famous world! 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: The Faceless Mob
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
A pack with an offer you cant refuse.

*20 Outfits
*80 Total Skins
*2 skins free

items.title: Luxury Mobs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Not all mobs live in the wild, these live in luxury!

*12 luxury mobs
*2 skins free

items.title: Cyberpunk
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description:
A tall city with vast buildings in a dystopian future. Start off your survival world journey in this detailed build with large skyscrapers with a unique design. Trade your iron to get vehicles to get around the world with choices like taxis, bikes, police cars and others! Multiple seating options in vehicles to bring your friends along! 

- Custom vehicles

items.title: The Ultimate Dropper
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
The Ultimate Dropper is a fun Minecraft dropper map with 9 different levels. Just reach the bottom of each level without dying to complete it. Have fun exploring the different ways to finish the levels!

- 7 main levels.
- 2 secret levels.
- 9 levels in total.
- By: Dannny0117 + MorganCreedFTW.
- Published By: Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Space Teens
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Space Teens are back in orbit!

+ 15 skins

items.title: Cat Teens
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description: Roleplay as a cat! Be the perfect furry teen in this new attire.

items.title: Player Mobs
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Roleplay as a mob with this fresh new skin pack! 10 to choose from!

+ 10 player mob skins!
+ Roleplay ready!

items.title: Modern Friends
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Live your new modern life with your friends! Roleplay through the day as a teen dressed in fresh new fashion!

+ 15 skins included!
+ Inspired by modern trends!

items.title: Rainbow Teens Pride
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Stand out and show your pride with a brand new skin pack by In Mine. Tailored with love for everyone who is willing to be loved and to show love.

+ Pride
+ Rainbow
+ Teenage love
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
